# Harness helpers

These helpers are copied without modification for exact target decoding and diagnostic grading. They contain no reference solutions or audit classifications. The three supplied steps reproduce code visible to evaluated models.

- `process_data.py`, `test_util.py`: `xantheocracy/inspect_evals`, commit `51f92017ccbdc63bd768ed6aba36942d43243b25`, `src/inspect_evals/scicode/`.
- `verified/scicode/` and `provided/`: `xantheocracy/scicode-verified`, commit `3fd9ef2713244d58f6cfeab5a5d92c10e2b907de`, `eval_clean/vendor/`.
- Upstream SciCode license is included in `LICENSE`; individual files retain their source notices.
